cover: Escalating regional clashes and political upheaval test global stability
cover_scene: A split composition showing an industrial refinery blazing against a twilight sky beside a tense legislative assembly hall flanked by national flags.

slides.scene: A massive energy processing facility engulfed in towering flames and thick smoke beneath a dark night sky in northern Iraq.
slides.headline: Drone strike shuts Iraqi gas field and sparks blackout
slides.body: Iranian drone strikes struck the Khor Mor gas field in Iraqi Kurdistan, halting energy production immediately. The assault triggered widespread power outages affecting over seventy percent of the region, threatening electricity stability as wider Persian Gulf hostilities intensify.

slides.scene: The imposing neoclassical pillars of the United States Capitol under dramatic overcast skies, flanked by American flags.
slides.headline: House lawmaker moves to impeach Pete Hegseth
slides.body: Republican Representative Thomas Massie introduced eight articles of impeachment against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, forcing an imminent House vote. Massie accuses Hegseth of abuse of power and conducting unauthorized military operations, including an undeclared conflict with Iran.

slides.scene: Rows of empty glass-door grocery refrigerators glowing in cold neon light inside a quiet, shadowed French supermarket.
slides.headline: France accuses Iranian forces of supermarket cyberattacks
slides.body: French authorities formally blamed Iran's Revolutionary Guard for orchestrating cyberattacks that disabled refrigeration across nationwide supermarket chains, spoiling tons of food. Paris announced judicial proceedings and targeted sanctions as European intelligence confronts expanding hybrid warfare on civilian infrastructure.

slides.scene: A sprawling microchip fabrication cleanroom filled with automated robotic machinery glowing beneath sharp sterile lighting.
slides.headline: Nvidia CEO affair probe triggers stock tumble
slides.body: Nvidia shares plummeted over four percent after CEO Jensen Huang admitted to a relationship with a purported Chinese spy. The company launched an internal inquiry into potential foreign espionage risks, prompting Huang to abruptly cancel major artificial intelligence conference appearances.

slides.scene: An outdoor altar adorned with flowers facing a sea of worshippers waving Argentine and Vatican flags in Buenos Aires.
slides.headline: Pope Francis returns to native Argentina
slides.body: Pope Francis arrived in Buenos Aires, marking his first papal trip home since his 2013 election. The pontiff faces delicate political terrain with President Javier Milei while holding public liturgies just weeks after undergoing lung cancer surgery.
